statement: Given integer $n\geq 2$. Suppose point $P$ inside a convex cyclic $2n$-gon $A_1\cdots A_{2n}$ satisfies $\angle PA_1A_2=\angle PA_2A_3=\cdots=\angle PA_{2n}A_1$. Prove $\prod_{i=1}^n|A_{2i-1}A_{2i}|=\prod_{i=1}^n|A_{2i}A_{2i+1}|$ (where $A_{2n+1}=A_1$).

$n$ people attend a party with at most $n$ friend pairs. Two people shake hands iff they have at least 1 common friend. Given $m\geq 3$ with $n\leq m^3$. Prove there exists person $A$ such that the number of people shaking hands with $A$ is at most $m-1$ times the number of $A$'s friends.

(1) Let $a,b$ be coprime positive integers. Prove there exist constants $\lambda,\beta$ such that $|\sum_{k=1}^{m-1}\{ak/m\}\{bk/m\}-\lambda m|\leq\beta$ for all integers $m$. (2) Prove there exists $N$ such that for all primes $p>N$ and positive integers $a,b,c$ with $p\nmid(a+b)(b+c)(c+a)$, there are at least $\lfloor p/12\rfloor$ values $k\in\{1,\ldots,p-1\}$ with $\{ak/p\}+\{bk/p\}+\{ck/p\}\leq 1$.

Given $m,n\in\mathbb{N}^+$, let $S(m,n)=\{(a,b)\in\mathbb{N}_+^2:1\leq a\leq m,1\leq b\leq n,\gcd(a,b)=1\}$. Prove: for all $d,r\in\mathbb{N}^+$, there exist $m,n\geq d$ with $|S(m,n)|\equiv r\pmod{d}$.

Let $\triangle ABC$ have $n$ interior points $P_1,\ldots,P_n$ with no three collinear. Prove one can partition $\triangle ABC$ into $2n+1$ triangles with vertices in $\{A,B,C,P_1,\ldots,P_n\}$ such that at least $n+\sqrt{n+1}$ of them contain at least one of $A,B,C$.

(1) Each line through the origin (except the real axis) contains at most one $z$ with $\frac{1+z^{23}}{z^{64}}\in\mathbb{R}$. (2) For any nonzero complex $a$ and real $\theta$, the equation $1+z^{23}+az^{64}=0$ has a root in $S_\theta=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:\mathrm{Re}(ze^{-i\theta})\geq|z|\cos(\pi/20)\}$.

Given integer $n\geq 2$ and $a$ coprime to $n$. A country has $n$ islands $D_1,\ldots,D_n$. There is a one-way ferry $D_i\to D_j$ iff $ij\equiv i^a\pmod{n}$ ($i\neq j$). A tourist flies to any island and takes ferries. What is the maximum number of islands they can visit?

Non-isosceles acute $\triangle ABC$ with altitudes $AP,BQ,CR$ and orthocenter $H$. $A_1$ is midpoint of $BC$, $AA_1\cap QR=K$, $QR\cap(\text{line through }A\parallel BC)=D$, and $A_2$ is where the line through midpoint of $AH$ and $K$ meets $DA_1$. Define $B_2,C_2$ similarly. Given $\triangle A_2B_2C_2$ is non-degenerate with circumcircle $\omega$, prove there exist circles $\odot A',\odot B',\odot C'$ inside and tangent to $\omega$ where $\odot A'$ is tangent to $AB,AC$; $\odot B'$ to $BC,BA$; $\odot C'$ to $CA,CB$; and $A',B',C'$ are distinct and collinear.

Find the largest positive integer $m$ such that one can color cells of a $70\times 70$ table red satisfying: no two red cells share a row with the same number of red cells AND a column with the same number of red cells; AND there are two rows each with exactly $m$ red cells.

A nonempty integer set $A$ is elegant if for any $a\in A$ and $1\leq k\leq 2023$, $|\{b\in A:\lfloor b/3^k\rfloor=\lfloor a/3^k\rfloor\}|=2^k$. Prove: if $S$ intersects every elegant set, then $S$ contains an elegant set.
Let $n\in\mathbb{N}^+$ and $a_{ijk}\in\{-1,1\}$ for $1\leq i,j,k\leq n$. Prove there exist $x_i,y_j,z_k\in\{-1,1\}$ such that $|\sum_{i,j,k}a_{ijk}x_iy_jz_k|>n^{2/3}$.
Prove there exists a positive real $\lambda$ such that for any $D>1$, there is an acute lattice triangle $\triangle ABC$ with $AB,BC,CA>D$ and area $<\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4}D^2+\lambda D^{4/5}$.
Does there exist a positive irrational $x$ such that only finitely many positive integers $n$ satisfy: for every integer $1\leq k\leq n$, $\{kx\}\geq\frac{1}{n+1}$?

For nonempty finite $B\subset\mathbb{R}$ and real $x$, let $d_B(x)=\min_{b\in B}|x-b|$. (1) Given positive integer $m$, find the smallest $\lambda$ (depending on $m$) such that for any $n$ and $x_1,\ldots,x_n\in[0,1]$, there exists an $m$-element set $B$ with $\sum d_B(x_i)\leq\lambda n$. (2) Given $m$ and $\varepsilon>0$, prove there exist $n$ and $x_1,\ldots,x_n\geq 0$ such that for any $m$-element $B$, $\sum d_B(x_i)>(1-\varepsilon)\sum x_i$.

For convex quadrilateral $ABCD$, call interior point $P$ balanced if $P\notin AC\cup BD$ and letting $AP,BP,CP,DP$ meet boundaries at $A',B',C',D'$: $AP\cdot PA'=BP\cdot PB'=CP\cdot PC'=DP\cdot PD'$. Find the maximum number of balanced points.

Mutually tangent circles $\Gamma,\Gamma_1,\Gamma_2$ also tangent to line $l$. $\Gamma\cap\Gamma_1=B_1$, $\Gamma\cap\Gamma_2=B_2$, $\Gamma_1\cap\Gamma_2=C$. $\Gamma,\Gamma_1,\Gamma_2$ touch $l$ at $A,A_1,A_2$ ($A$ between $A_1,A_2$). Let $D_1=A_1C\cap A_2B_2$ and $D_2=A_2C\cap A_1B_1$. Prove $D_1D_2\parallel l$.
Are there distinct integers $a_1,a_2,\ldots$ satisfying: (1) $a_k^2>0$ and $a_{k^2+k}<0$ for all $k\in\mathbb{N}^+$; (2) $|a_{n+1}-a_n|\leq 2023\sqrt{n}$ for all $n\in\mathbb{N}^+$?

Find the greatest constant $\lambda$ such that for any doubly stochastic $100\times 100$ matrix, one can pick 150 entries such that setting all others to 0, each row and column sum is at least $\lambda$.

On unit circle $\omega$, fix $A,B$ with $\sqrt{2}<AB<2$. Let $P$ move on $\omega$ with $\triangle ABP$ acute and $AP>AB>BP$. Let $H$ be the orthocenter of $\triangle ABP$, $S$ on minor arc $AP$ with $SH=AH$, $T$ on minor arc $AB$ with $TB\parallel AP$, and $Q=ST\cap BP$. Prove the circle with diameter $HQ$ passes through a fixed point.

Let $a,b,d$ be integers with $|a|\geq 2$, $d\geq 0$, $b\geq(|a|+1)^{d+1}$. For degree-$d$ real polynomial $f$ and integer $n$, let $r_n=\lfloor f(n)\cdot a^n\rfloor\bmod b$. If $\{r_n\}$ is eventually periodic, prove all coefficients of $f$ are rational.
Given integer $n\geq 2$, find the minimum $\lambda$ such that for any reals $a_1,\ldots,a_n$ and $b$: $\lambda\sum\sqrt{|a_i-b|}+\sqrt{|\sum a_i|}\geq\sum\sqrt{|a_i|}$.
Find all $f:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathbb{Z}$ such that for any integers $a,b,c$: $2f(a^2+b^2+c^2)-2f(ab+bc+ca)=f(a-b)^2+f(b-c)^2+f(c-a)^2$.

Given prime $p$ and $\lambda\in(0,1)$. Let $s\leq t<\frac{\lambda p}{12}$ and $S,T$ be sets of $s,t$ consecutive positive integers with $|\{(x,y)\in S\times T:kx\equiv y\pmod{p}\}|\geq 1+\lambda s$. Prove there exist integers $a,b$ with $1\leq a\leq 1/\lambda$, $|b|\leq t/(\lambda s)$, and $ka\equiv b\pmod{p}$.

Let $n$ be a positive integer. A $2n\times 2n$ grid has $k$ black cells. Operations: (1) if a $2\times 2$ square has exactly 3 black, the 4th turns black; (2) if a $2\times 2$ has exactly 2 black, swap colors. Find the smallest $k$ such that any initial configuration with $k$ black cells can be made all-black.
